data.name: medium
text:
torque_spike (medium)
page: DUL-006_DDR_2020-04-23.pdf#p1
cause: Sharp torque increase on contact with Girujan, ROP dropped to near zero.
remedy: Reduced WOB and RPM, reamed interval, resumed drilling at reduced parameters.
NPT: 2.79 h

overpressure (medium)
page: DUL-006_DDR_2020-04-28.pdf#p1
cause: Well kicked back while circulating out of Barail, gas readings elevated on trip gas.
remedy: Weighted mud up to balance formation pressure, circulated bottoms up before resuming.
NPT: 3.72 h

torque_spike (medium)
page: DUL-006_DDR_2020-05-01.pdf#p1
cause: Sharp torque increase on contact with Basement, ROP dropped to near zero.
remedy: Reduced WOB and RPM, reamed interval, resumed drilling at reduced parameters.

data.name: low
text:
wellbore_instability (low)
page: DUL-006_DDR_2020-04-24.pdf#p1
cause: Wellbore washout suspected in Girujan, oversized cuttings at surface.
remedy: Adjusted mud rheology, ran wiper trips before continuing.
NPT: 1.74 h

data.name: critical
text:
overpressure (critical)
page: DUL-006_DDR_2020-04-26.pdf#p1
cause: SPP trend increasing and drag rising while drilling into Barail, suspected transition zone.
remedy: Raised mud weight in 26-ppg steps, monitored trip gas, continued drilling with caution.
NPT: 9.13 h
